description: Manifest of demo video clips fetched from CC-licensed sources. fetch-demo-clips.sh reads this to download + transcode each clip; the demo fixture bundles reference clips by id. Clip media files are NOT committed to git — see ../clips/.gitignore.

sources.title: Nils Frahm — 'Says' Live at KEXP
sources.notes: Multi-camera radio session of 'Says', 5:07 long. The clips below extract distinct camera framings the KEXP editor cut to at different moments of one continuous performance — all timestamps are inside the actual source duration.

clips.framing: early wide stage shot, piano lead
close-up on the synth — Frahm shaping a phrase by hand
wider stage shot during mid-piece textural section
opening seconds with intro chord and Frahm visible
mid-performance wide showing the multi-instrument setup
later wide shot — alternate camera angle on the piano
near-end close-up — same instrument from a different framing

note: All 8 clips come from the single 2015 KEXP 'Says' upload — multiple camera angles cut to at different moments of one continuous performance. The earlier manifest assumed a 2018 second session that turns out to be unavailable on YouTube; if a second source comes back online, drop it into sources[] and re-point the last two clips' sourceId. Clip IDs stay stable so the fixture bundles continue to resolve.
